$comment: Project knowledge only. Anything here that every project would copy verbatim belongs in orch instead.

verify.$comment: How the acceptance hook (hooks/session-idle) is bounded. retryCap caps how many times a failing verification re-prompts the agent before the task lands on needs-review.

scheduler.$comment: Auto-dispatch of todo tasks (wait_human_start: false only): the daemon fills free maxConcurrent slots with the next unclaimed task. opencode-orchestrator turns this on by default for `orch init` and `orch project create`; a cloned project starts with it off. Edit with `orch project scheduler <n>`; only the committed copy on the base branch applies.
